scope: Review current cq-acis release and corpus provenance, bound its parser/conversion evidence, and refine optional ACIS/AcDs semantic-check readiness without promoting format or consumer support.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project documentation, package release metadata, corpus manifest, upstream data repository, and consumer documentation
method.evidenceRule: Treat cq-acis as an optional exact-version bare-payload parser/converter. Separate source provenance, SAT/SAB decoding, complete body coverage, OCCT-family shape construction, independent analytic truth, AcDs ownership, native FreeCAD acceptance, and platform evidence. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

observed: PyPI identifies 0.3.12 as released on 2026-10-16 and lists macOS ARM64/x86-64, Linux x86-64/ARM64, and Windows x86-64 wheels.
The project describes its parser and shape-conversion scopes separately and labels the project experimental.
The current mutable main documentation is not assumed to match the attested 0.3.12 source unless exact source identity is checked.
findings.disposition: Optional pinned candidate only; no runtime or support inference.

observed: The corpus manifest records upstream repository/commit, Git blob SHA-1, artifact SHA-256/size, ACIS save-version/header fields, structural inventory, and a notice reference.
Listed examples include NIST SAT variants and ezdxf-authored SAT 400/700 and ASM-SAB 21800/22300 controls.
Generated structural counts are not independently authored geometry expectations and do not witness DWG or AcDs association.
findings.disposition: Potential optional direct-payload parser/profile sample after exact hash and notice review; do not copy into repository fixtures or use as standalone semantic truth.

observed: The upstream repository describes the collection as public-domain industry CAD models and provides the data as-is.
NIST general guidance warns third-party materials may have separate rights; a corpus-level NIST-PD label does not remove the need to check the exact model path and notice.
findings.disposition: Prefer local analytic controls; any optional fetched sample stays in scratch and is not redistributed absent file-level review.

observed: The current geometry documentation describes bounded analytic and experimental profiles, unsupported referenced geometry, and explicit conversion failure rather than silent partial solids.
The conversion backend is CadQuery/OpenCascade, sharing the OCCT kernel family with FreeCAD; cq-acis does not parse DWG AcDs owner/page linkage.
FreeCAD documentation describes DWG conversion through an external converter into its DXF importer, with the selected DXF backend restrictions still applying.
findings.disposition: Keep parser, OCCT shape, analytic truth, AcDs join, and exact native FreeCAD Linux/Windows checks as separate non-transitive evidence.

existingGatesRefined: S2/S3 ACIS payload and AcDs association
S8 semantic and native consumer qualification
